reasons.simulator: You're on a simulator. Push tokens only work on a real device.
reasons.permissionDenied: Notification permission is OFF. Open iOS Settings → Notifications → Expo Go → enable Allow Notifications, then tap this button again.
reasons.noProjectId: Couldn't find the Expo projectId. Restart the app from the QR code.
reasons.tokenFetchFailed: Expo could not issue a push token. Common causes: no internet, Apple Push servers blocked on this network.
reasons.backendRegisterFailed: Got a token from Expo but our API rejected it. Check that you're signed in.
